state.instructions: You are given one record of a network flow, described by the columns listed below. Decide whether the flow is an intrusion attempt or normal traffic, and which category it belongs to. Labeled example records may be provided; use them as reference. Judge the record by its own values: do not assume a category is present only because it appears among the examples.

categories.BENIGN: legitimate traffic of the testbed users and services, such as web browsing, e-mail, file downloads and streaming.
categories.API: attacks on REST, GraphQL or SOAP interfaces through crafted requests.
categories.Bruteforce: repeated login attempts against a service, guessing credentials.
categories.BufferOverflow: requests that overflow a buffer of a network service.
categories.C2Beaconing: an infected host contacting its command-and-control server at regular intervals.
categories.DDoS: distributed denial of service, several hosts flooding one target at the same time.
categories.DNS: abuse of the DNS protocol, such as amplification or flooding.
categories.DoS: denial of service from one host, flooding a target with packets or requests.
categories.Evasion: traffic crafted to slip past detection, such as fragmented packets or unusual TTL values.
categories.Exfiltration: data copied out of the network to a host outside it.
categories.MITM: a man-in-the-middle host intercepting or relaying the traffic between two others.
categories.PortScan: scans that probe the ports of the hosts of the network.
categories.Slowloris: slow requests that hold the connections of a web server open until it runs out of them.
categories.TLSSSL: anomalous TLS or SSL handshakes and sessions.
categories.WebBased: attacks on a web application through crafted requests, such as injected queries or scripts.

is_attack.instructions: Is the flow `flows.under_test` an intrusion attempt rather than normal traffic? Judge it by `instructions` and `columns`, and by the labeled `examples` when they are present.

category.instructions: Which category in `categories` does the flow `flows.under_test` belong to?
